name: Ricotta Fruit Salad with Almonds
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add almonds and toast, stirring often, until golden brown, 2-3 minutes. Set aside to cool.
In a medium bowl, whisk together ricotta, milk, and honey.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the bananas, halve lengthwise, and slice.
Trim off the ends and peel the kiwis; quarter lengthwise, then chop crosswise.
To serve, transfer ricotta mixture to bowls; top with fruit and almonds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
